lines.zh: 我走得很低，脊背几乎平。
lines.en: I walk low, my back almost level.

lines.zh: 四条腿撑着我，后腿更粗。
lines.en: Four legs carry me; the hind ones are thicker.
I walk slowly along the muddy bank.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草压成一条线。
lines.en: The grass lies in a line where I pass.

lines.zh: 我的头很大，走起来往下沉。
lines.en: My head is heavy and dips as I walk.
I keep close to the ground.
I push through the ferns and they part.
I'm looking for a bank to lie up on.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很轻，你不一定听见。
lines.en: My steps are light. You might not hear them.
I withdraw from the water into the trees.
I skirt the open ground, not crossing it.
Step by step, testing.
My tail drags through the mud.

lines.zh: 我先伏低，再一下扑出去。
lines.en: I drop low first, then lunge.

lines.zh: 我伏着，只露出一条脊背。
lines.en: I lie low with only my back showing.
I'm waiting. I've been waiting a long time.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很浅，几乎没声。
lines.en: My breathing is shallow and almost silent.
Something is coming from the water's edge.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛跟着它，头不动。
lines.en: My eyes track it while my head stays still.

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，牙齿出来了。
lines.en: I open my mouth and the teeth show.

lines.zh: 蕨叶上的水珠滴到我背上。
lines.en: Drops from the ferns fall on my back.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，连尾巴都不动。
lines.en: I don't move, not even my tail.
I can wait like this all day.

lines.zh: 太阳偏过去了，我还伏着。
lines.en: The sun has turned and I'm still here.
My markings match the mud.

lines.zh: 猎物走到我的范围里了。
lines.en: The prey has entered my range.
I slowly coil my hind legs.
Not yet. A little closer.
You've walked up to where I lie.
I raise my head, and only then do you see me.

lines.zh: 芦草晃了一下，是我的背。
lines.en: The reeds moved; that was my back.
My jaw rests on the ground and I do not move.
This jaw of mine opens wide.

lines.zh: 你比我高，可我不站起来。
lines.en: You're taller. I won't stand up.
I'm looking at your knees.

lines.zh: 你的脚踝，就在我嘴边的距离。
lines.en: Your ankle is a jaw's length from my mouth.

lines.zh: 我的后腿已经收在身下。
lines.en: My hind legs are already gathered under me.
One lunge is all it takes.

lines.zh: 钦利组的泥，我伏得最深。
lines.en: In Chinle mud, I crouch the deepest.
Now you do.
I roll over and lie back down.

lines.zh: 这一下，把我从伏击里打出来了。
lines.en: That knocked me out of my ambush.
There's a white line across my scales.
I growl low and don't retreat.

lines.zh: 这一击砸在背脊的硬鳞上。
lines.en: The hit came down on the hard scales of my spine.

lines.zh: 我拖着一条腿，挪了几步。
lines.en: I drag a leg and shift a few paces.
It hurts, and I can still spring.

lines.zh: 我的腿跛了，还是朝你爬。
lines.en: Lame as I am, I still crawl at you.
You stepped in the wrong place.
My ground won't suffer you standing there.
Blood smell. Very close.
You set it down. I haven't moved.
I'm waiting for one more step from you.
That's easier than catching something alive.
I stretch my head out slowly.
My teeth have touched it.
I'm in no hurry to eat.
Step back first, then I'll move.
This will last me a day.
Stand still and watch me eat.
You kicked me and I'm not letting go.
The shove slides me into the mud.
That should hurt your ankle.
I draw back a little and lie down again.
You shoved me off with your foot.
I crawl half a circle around you.

lines.zh: 我的爪子抓住你的靴子。
lines.en: My claws catch your boot.

lines.zh: 你踩进我伏的泥里，滑了一下。
lines.en: You step into the mud I lie in and slip.

lines.zh: 你把我从伏击点撞了出来。
lines.en: You knocked me out of my ambush spot.
You haven't got far.
My kind lies up over in the bend.

lines.zh: 我们隔着一段泥，谁也没靠近。
lines.en: We keep a stretch of mud between us.
It's bigger than me, broader in the back.
We each lie up on our own first.
After a while it moves closer.

lines.zh: 我们的头碰在一起，很短。
lines.en: Our heads touch, briefly.

lines.zh: 巢做在干土里，盖着叶子。
lines.en: The nest goes in dry soil, covered with leaves.
We'll guard it without eating or drinking.
If something comes, I go first.

lines.zh: 这是我的地，也是它们的。
lines.en: This is my ground, and theirs.

lines.zh: 我一爪按住，先看一眼四周。
lines.en: I pin it with one claw and check around first.
I drag it into the ferns.
That mouthful, bones and all.
I tear off a piece and toss it back.

lines.zh: 三叠纪的顶级掠食者，是我。
lines.en: The Triassic's top predator. That is me.
Two bites and it's gone.
Not enough for me.
This meat smells of waterweed.
I lie low and wait again.
There'll be a next meal.
A shape at the water's edge.
It's lowering its head to drink.
This is the best moment.
I press my body to the ground.
My hind legs are already coiled.
Only a few steps of mud between.
Its ears turn toward me.
It's drinking, head down in the mud.
It's lowered again.
It's put its neck down.
I burst up out of the mud.
Mud flies under my feet.
It turned and saw me.
Slower than I expected.
I chase along the ground.

lines.zh: 它往林子里跑，那里树密。
lines.en: It runs for the trees, where they're thick.

lines.zh: 树密对它不利，对我有利。
lines.en: Thick trees hurt it. They help me.
I keep low and pass underneath.
It can't jump clear.
I bit only air; my teeth clacked.
It put a foot on me.
I wrench my head and bring it down.
We roll into the mud together.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的前胸往下拽。
lines.en: I bite its chest and drag it down.
I roll and pin it back.
My teeth find their place.

lines.zh: 它的蹄在我肚皮下乱蹬。
lines.en: Its hooves kick wildly under my belly.
Then slows.
It has stopped struggling.
I spring and take its neck.
That bite went all the way.

lines.zh: 它把我甩开，我翻滚起来。
lines.en: It throws me off and I roll up.
I spring in and bite again.
It kicks me in the ribs.
I rake its face with a foreclaw.

lines.zh: 我们扭在一起，泥飞起来。
lines.en: We wrestle and mud sprays.
I lock onto its leg and hold.
It goes down on its side.

lines.zh: 我咬着它的喉咙，往泥里按。
lines.en: I hold its throat and press it into the mud.
It goes slack in my jaws.
I lift my head and look around.
Nothing else.
I lower my head and begin to eat.
I raise my head out of the ferns.
This place smells of mud and water.
I lie low first and look around.
Something's moving past the trees.
My markings match the dead leaves.
I inch forward a foot.
There are other prints in the mud.
These prints aren't mine.
I follow the prints.
My mouth is shut. Teeth inside.
When it opens, it'll be too late.

lines.zh: 三叠纪的沼泽，和这里像。
lines.en: Triassic marsh. Much like this.
I know that sound of water.
I find a bank and lie up.
Now I wait.
I don't move. Nothing moves.
Only my eyes still move.
And the wind. Nothing else.

lines.zh: 火燎到我背上，我滚进泥里。
lines.en: Fire catches my back and I roll in the mud.

lines.zh: 我从坡上摔下，砸在蕨丛里。
lines.en: I fall from the slope into the ferns.

lines.zh: 泥水进了我的嘴，我抬不起头。
lines.en: Muddy water fills my mouth and I can't lift my head.

lines.zh: 一声炸响，我被掀起来又砸下去。
lines.en: A blast lifts me and slams me back down.

lines.zh: 我先伏在泥里，再一口扑出去。
lines.en: I lie in the mud first, then lunge.
A force pins me to the ground.

lines.zh: 我伏了很久，什么都没来。
lines.en: I've lain here a long time and nothing came.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，我整条都绷紧。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my back and I go rigid.

lines.zh: 下面没有泥，我一直在落。
lines.en: No mud below. I keep falling.
